data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Amariel is a female name meaning 'God is my God'. This name may be derived from the Hebrew words ‘amar’ (God) and ‘el’ (God). It is a beautiful and meaningful name for a little girl in the Christian faith. The name Amariel carries the meaning “God is my God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Amariel usually hope their child will grow to embody god is my god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Amariel total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: During the Middle Ages, the name Amariel became popular in Europe due to its old-world charm, and its association with the Christian faith.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Amariel is a constant reminder of the belief that God is always with us, providing comfort, strength, and guidance.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Amariel, meaning "God's Bitterness" or "God's Bitter Tear," symbolizes the deep sorrow and compassion of God for humanity's suffering and fall from grace. It is a reminder of the bittersweet nature of divine love and the redemptive power of tears.

biblical_reference.note: not directly mentioned in the Bible

historical_references.reference: Amariel, the guardian angel of the city of Paris, is said to have appeared during the Middle Ages, particularly in the legend that describes her intervention during the Siege of Paris in 885-886 AD, when she guided Charles III, the Simple to victory against the Vikings.

The name Amariel is also associated with the character Amariel Sunflower, a saint and martyr from the early Christian period, who was born in the city of Amasya in Anatolia (modern-day Turkey) around 280 AD and was martyred during the persecutions of Diocletian.
historical_references.context: Early Christian period, Martyrdom of Amariel

In the realm of spirituality and New Age movements, Amariel is adopted as a spiritual name and is the focus of various practices and beliefs.
